I EVEN CONSIDERED BLOGGING ABOUT SOMETHING ELSE'). 11=D (Damon: 'initially exposing myself MADE ME FEEL REALLY UNCOMFORTABLE'). 12=E (Ellen: 'I'D SOONER BE A FILM DIRECTOR than a critic').

r13.exp: 'Infectious diseases existed during humankind's HUNTER-GATHERER days' = utjecale su na lovačko-sakupljačka društva = C.

r14.exp: 'Built more cities, forged TRADE ROUTES... the more likely pandemics became' = gradovi i trgovina olakšali pandemije = A.

r15.exp: 'Claiming Emperor Marcus Aurelius as one of its VICTIMS' = zarazio rimskog cara = D.

r16.exp: 'Believed to be A PUNISHMENT FROM GOD' = smatralo se božanskom kaznom = B.

r17.exp: 'People with the plague ARRIVED in the port of Messina FROM THE FAR EAST' = doputovali = A.

r18.exp: 'Weakened the population so they were unable to RESIST THE SPANISH COLONIZERS' = pomoglo Španjolcima da osvoje Amerike = C.

r19.exp: 'Most people learn to write by reproducing letters from a copybook. (19)____. It is based on each writer's PERCEPTION and MOTOR SKILLS.' → F: This ABILITY TO COPY THE LETTERS VARIES from one child to the next.

r20.exp: 'Mastered through practice and repetition. (20)____. They deviate from the copybook forms.' → B: Once THIS OCCURS (mastered through practice), writers FOCUS ON THE SUBJECT MATTER rather than the physical act of writing.

r21.exp: 'Other forces create a UNIQUE STYLE for each person. (21)____.' → D: Even IDENTICAL TWINS do not have the SAME handwriting. Emphasises uniqueness.

r22.exp: 'Identical twins share a HIGH DEGREE OF SIMILARITY. (22)____.' → C: However, THESE STUDIES all found that trained experts were ABLE TO DISTINGUISH between the handwriting of twins.

r23.exp: 'Lay people observe ONLY the obvious features. (23)____. SUBTLETIES may differentiate handwriting.' → G: In CONTRAST, experts can tell the difference between BOTH THE OBVIOUS FEATURES AND THE LESS CONSPICUOUS ELEMENTS.

r24.exp: 'Experts evaluate many features. (24)____. Rather, it is proved through a COMBINATION of significant features.' → A: A writer's identity CANNOT BE ESTABLISHED THROUGH A SINGLE INDIVIDUAL FEATURE.

r25.exp: 'Health-RELATED climate indicators' — fiksna složenica: health-related = koji se odnosi na zdravlje.

r26.exp: 'Timely to BETTER understand the link' — 'better' kao prilog (to understand better = bolje razumjeti).

r27.exp: 'Conditions to WHICH we are accustomed' — relativna zamjenica 'which' uz prijedlog (accustomed to which).

r28.exp: 'Threats to HUMAN health and wellbeing' — fiksna kolokacija: human health = zdravlje ljudi.

r29.exp: 'Frequency or SEVERITY of extreme weather events' — 'severity' = ozbiljnost, intenzitet (severity of events).

r30.exp: 'Climate change COULD require adjustments' — 'could' za mogućnost u budućnosti (nije sigurno, ali je moguće).

r31.exp: 'Sensitivity TO climate change' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: sensitivity to = osjetljivost na.

r32.exp: 'Ability to ADAPT to or cope with climate change' — fiksna kolokacija: adapt to = prilagoditi se nečemu.

r33.exp: 'Casual chattiness is SEEN as needless' — passive voice: be seen as = biti viđeno/smatrano kao.

r34.exp: 'Small talk is THOUGHT to be futile' — passive: be thought to be = smatrati se.

r35.exp: 'Staring at shopping windows INSTEAD' — 'instead' = umjesto toga (instead of engaging with people).

r36.exp: 'ENGAGING in purposeless chit-chat simply isn't valued' — gerund: engaging in = sudjelovanje u.

r37.exp: 'Are likely to BE met with a flat hej' — likely to + bare infinitive: to be met (passive infinitive).

r38.exp: 'Could be DUE TO Sweden being a sparsely populated country' — fiksna konstrukcija: due to + gerund/noun = zbog.

r39.exp: 'Less inclined to TAKE up this practice' — frazalni glagol: take up = prihvatiti, usvojiti (praksu).

r40.exp: 'DESPITE their seemingly cool and reserved exterior' — prijedlog kontrasta: despite + noun/gerund = unatoč.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA fakultetsku diplomu: bolji prihodi, više mogućnosti zapošljavanja, razvoj vještina, prestiž. PROTIV: praktično iskustvo vrijedi više, skupo, nije potrebno u svim karijerama, samouki uspjeh. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
